A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Good questions.
Clear answers.

What does the DigiFlovv system do?

It automatically supplies water to plants according to a predefined schedule. You can configure watering times and durations to reduce daily manual watering.

Can I control it with my phone?

The product documentation describes remote control through a connected mobile application. Supported phones, app availability, and connectivity requirements are still to be confirmed.

Will it work for my plants?

Watering schedules and durations can be adjusted for different plants. Final capacity, watering-line support, and installation requirements will be confirmed before purchase. Suitability depends on your plants and setup.

Does it automatically detect dry soil?

Soil sensing is not confirmed in the current product information. The documented system waters on a schedule you configure. Monitor your plants and adjust that schedule as needed.

Can it water my plants while I’m away?

The system is designed to continue scheduled watering during your absence. Check the setup, power, and water supply before leaving, and follow the final product instructions.

What is the price, and what’s included?

Pricing, taxes, shipping charges, and package contents have not yet been finalized. These details will be shown before orders open.

What about delivery, returns, and warranty?

Delivery locations and timelines, return and refund terms, and warranty coverage are pending confirmation. Please review the final terms before placing an order.
